name: SermonSmith
guidance: Install repository dependencies and platform toolchains first. Auto uses the build host; explicit target names the recipient. iOS/Safari use web; native Apple distribution requires separate signing and existing release procedures.

web.notice: Browser build for web; no native installer or Apple signing. Recipients sign in with their own account.

safari.notice: Browser build for safari; no native installer or Apple signing. Recipients sign in with their own account.

ios.notice: Browser build for ios; no native installer or Apple signing. Recipients sign in with their own account.

windows.notice: Local build only. Signing/notarization requires configured publisher credentials; no release is uploaded.

macos.notice: Local build only. Signing/notarization requires configured publisher credentials; no release is uploaded.

android.notice: Debug-signed test APK, not a production release. Requires installed Capacitor dependencies, Java21 and Android SDK. Use the existing gated release workflow for production signing.
